A '''tree-dwelling creature''' lived on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. It had [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] with black pupils, and numerous white [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], two [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]] from [[King/Legends|King]] [[Gorneesh/Legends|Gorneesh's]] [[Gorneesh's tribe|tribe]] encountered one of the creatures in a [[Tree/Legends|tree]] after failing to kidnap the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Latara/Legends|Latara]].

==Biology and appearance==
The [[Tree/Legends|tree]]-dwelling creature had two blinking [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]&mdash;which were significantly larger than those of a [[Dulok/Legends|Dulok]]&mdash;with vertical black pupils. It also had several sharp, white [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]].<ref name="Jindas" />

==History==
The creature made its home in a hollow tree on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].<ref name="Jindas" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="date">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=1905#14621041|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-04-20|time=11:42 AM|quote=The 3 ABY dating (technically, it should be 3.5) is from the timeline in Behind the Magic.}}</ref> two Duloks from [[King/Legends|King]] [[Gorneesh/Legends|Gorneesh's]] [[Gorneesh's tribe|tribe]]&mdash;who had a yellow ''[[Unidentified Dulok (X)|X]]'' and ''[[Unidentified Dulok (O)|O]]'' painted on their respective chests&mdash;were sent<ref name="Jindas" /> to [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]]<ref name="EGC 184">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> to capture the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Latara/Legends|Latara]] so they could enlist her as a babysitter at the [[Dulok Swamp]]. However, they were prevented from capturing the Ewok by the arrival of the [[Travelling Jindas]], a group of performers who had come to the village to entertain the Ewoks. The Duloks, frightened by the massive stature of the [[awor]]s, the Jindas' beasts of burden,<ref name="Jindas" /><ref>{{WebCite|url=http://ewokcels.com/collectibles.htm|text="Other Stuff: Non-Ewok Cartoon items you might want to see"|author=Maureen Kuppe|work=EwokCels.com|archivedate=20190901022420}}</ref> hid in the base of a hollow tree. The creature who lived there was alerted, and it opened its green eyes and glared at the Duloks. In the darkness, the Dulok marked with an ''X'' was able to see two sets of eyes and nothing else, and thus mistakenly called his counterpart "four-eyes" before the creature bared its sharp teeth and growled. A scuffle ensued, and the two Duloks managed to escape the tree.<ref name="Jindas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The tree-dwelling creature made its first appearance in "[[The Travelling Jindas]],"<ref name="Jindas" /> the fifth episode of the [[Ewoks: Season One|first season]] of the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] television series. "The Travelling Jindas," written by [[Bob Carrau]] and directed by [[Raymond Jafelice]], first aired on [[October 5]], [[1986]].<ref name="A Star Wars CELibration">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
